title: Token Economy & Context Kernel
brief: Establish graph-first/digest-first routing rules. Identify high-cost read paths. Implement bounded-read practices and response budgets per workflow. Target: <=30% token reduction vs current baseline.

units.title: Define graph-first vs digest-first routing rules per information type
Profile current token usage: identify top-10 high-cost read paths
Implement bounded-read practices: max lines per read, digest fallback thresholds
Define response budgets per workflow class (build/test/review/explore/create)
Implement budget enforcement: warn on overrun, compress on threshold
Baseline measurement and validation: confirm <=30% token reduction target on sample workflows

exit_conditions: Graph-first/digest-first routing rules documented and enforced
Top-10 high-cost read paths identified and mitigated
Token reduction <=30% validated on sample workflows
